title: Amendment before issuance of shares.
bodyText: If a corporation has not yet issued shares, its incorporators or board of directors may adopt one or more amendments to the corporation's articles of incorporation.
bodyHtml: [§414-285]  Amendment before issuance of shares.  If a corporation has not yet issued shares, its incorporators or board of directors may adopt one or more amendments to the corporation's articles of incorporation. [L 2000, c 244, pt of §1]
